well I understand you I think and I love to hear you sing and thanks for letting us talk to you Mahaya thank you right after this message we'll be joining Jack in Europe for the second half of Here's Hollywood is that right? yes that's right and I am happy well I can see that when you are singing

singing. Oh yes. And one can hear it. Well, why are you so happy? Well, the music makes the soul happy. And I think I sing all the time and it keeps my spirit happy. And you sing at home too? Oh yes. I sing when I'm cooking, when I'm working around the house. I sing so much till the neighbors sometimes come around and listen. So I just sing. It keeps me happy.
